fields.label: Device ID
fields.description: The machine, as its punches name it in `Employee Checkin.device_id`. A string rather than only a Link, because the bridge reads a machine's users whether or not anybody has registered the machine yet.

fields.label: Attendance Device
fields.description: Filled when this machine is on the Attendance Device list, which is what puts these people under it.

fields.label: User ID on Machine
fields.description: The number the machine calls this person. `Employee.attendance_device_id` has to be this same number, or every punch they make is refused.

fields.label: Name on Machine
fields.description: As typed at the machine when they were enrolled. Only a clue to who this is — the machine's keypad is not where names get spelt right.

fields.label: Role on Machine
fields.description: An Admin can open the machine's menu, which includes deleting its punch log. Worth knowing who they are.

fields.label: Employee
fields.description: Whoever has this number as Attendance Device ID. **Blank is the row that matters**: somebody who can punch and whose punches match nobody, so they read as absent every day.

fields.label: Still Enrolled
fields.description: Unticked when they are removed from the machine. The row stays, because their past punches still name this user id.

fields.label: Enrolled At
fields.description: When they appeared on the machine, to within one bridge poll. **Blank for anybody already enrolled when the bridge first read this machine** — the machine keeps no enrolment date, and a guessed one would be believed.

fields.label: First Seen by Bridge
fields.description: When the bridge first found them on the machine.

fields.label: Removed At
fields.description: When they disappeared from the machine, to within one poll.
